title: Ant Laboratory Out Now
author: AntLaboratory
selftext:
Your own digital formicarium. 

2.0 is the biggest update Ant Laboratory has had: a new look, lifelike water, day and night, a living lodge, and an island that lives on. It's free for everyone who has the game, and your colonies carry on right where you left them.

A new look  
Clear glass controls in forest green and brass, or pick Classic in Settings if you prefer the old look  
One sun lights everything: richer soil, carved tunnels and rooms, soft shadows and new plants  
Trees, bushes and flowers drawn anew for each season, and huge nests that look huge  
Room names appear as you zoom in

Water  
Smooth coasts, a sea from sand to turquoise to deep blue, and waves breaking into foam  
Streams with pools, riffles and grassy banks; ponds with stones and leaves on their beds  
Cracked ice, rain rings, and muddy floods in the nests

Day and night  
A slow sky: a full day and night in about 12 minutes, with stars and the moon  
Or follow your own local time, a fast time-lapse, or turn it off

The lodge comes alive  
It's now a real field station on the map, with a weather mast and solar panels, lit at night  
Its windows look out on your own island, season by season  
Tap the props: the food jar, the field guide, the magnifying lamp, the spray bottle  
Eight radio tracks

Look closer  
Put an ant under the lens: a brush lifts her into a dish, and you tap a body part to learn its name  
A field guide with a page for every species, drawn at true size  
Follow a worker to the end of her life, and the sister who carries her out  
The ant you follow glows softly, and the soil stays sharp right up close

The ant farm  
A new Clean tool to lift out the dead and spoilt food  
Warm one end or water one side, and nurses carry the brood where it grows best  
Rest your colony in winter  
Once there's room, the queen moves down into the heart of the nest

The island  
Mating flights: young queens found daughter colonies  
Wood ants grow into one supercolony  
Burnt land greens again, dead trees fall and young ones grow  
Plant trees and shrubs, and aphids settle on them to feed your ants

The keeper's notebook  
Data's charts flag every change you make: add notes and compare before and after  
A health card shows what's holding your colony back  
Plus seamless panning on the map, lots of polish and many smaller fixes.

Coming next: Android testing is about to begin for everyone who signed up, and I'm already working on 2.1.  
Thank you all for playing, for the feedback and for the kind words. This update was made with a lot of love. 🐜
